newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar edges higher but trade muted.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar edges higher but trade muted.

text.p: Activity was subdued on London's white sugar futures market on Friday with the nearby March/May spread accounting for most of the thin turnover, traders said.
"There's really nothing happening at the moment, a few crosses have gone through," said one trader, noting that March/May had widened out to $2.70.
Technically, the market remains firm and March is continuing along an upward channel, heading towards initial resistance at $305.50.
At 1240 GMT March was up 70 cents at $305.00 and May up 50 cents at $302.30. Volume was much lighter than earlier in the week and amounted to a thin 170 lots.
The Paris market was also quiet with just 64 lots posted on the board.
March was untraded and May stood 50 cents firmer at $302.00.
